summary.text: Jason Gearhart is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 64 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia notes that Gearhart served in the U.S. Army from 2004 to 2009 and works as an environmental specialist.

paragraphs.text: Jason Gearhart served in the U.S. Army from 2004 to 2009, according to Ballotpedia.
Gearhart earned a high school diploma from West Delaware High School and a bachelor's degree from Upper Iowa University.
Gearhart's career experience includes working as an environmental specialist, and Gearhart previously served on the Strawberry Point City Council.
Gearhart has also been a board member for the Strawberry Point Chamber of Commerce and the Jr. Stars Athletics Organization.
In the 2025-2026 session Gearhart was assigned to the House Agriculture, Natural Resources and Public Safety committees, and served as vice chair of the House Veterans Affairs Committee.
